item.title: Bible Verses About Beauty and Appearance
item.description: Our world sends confusing messages about beauty. These Bible verses about beauty and appearance remind us that true beauty begins in the heart, not the mirror. The post Bible Verses About Beauty and Appearance appeared first on Focus on the Family.

item.title: According to Scripture, is There Such a Thing as “Generational Curses”?
item.description: Many believers worry about "generational curses" when struggles like addiction or abuse repeat in families. As followers of Christ, we are no longer under the Law's curse — we are redeemed by Jesus' blood. So, what is the Bible talking about? The post According to Scripture, is There Such a Thing as “Generational Curses”? appeared first on Focus on the Family.

item.title: Warning Signs that Your Spouse Has Mental Health Issues
item.description: When spouses stay alert to changes in each other, they can catch warning signs of possible mental health issues early on and seek the help they need. Watch for drastic emotional, cognitive, physical, behavioral, or spiritual changes. If a souse needs help, it’s wise to initiate a gentle conversation, ask questions, and get an outside opinion. The post Warning Signs that Your Spouse Has Mental Health Issues appeared first on Focus on the Family.

item.title: Biblical View on Transgender Identity: A Primer
item.description: Those of us committed to the Christian worldview base our view of gender and sex on the Bible. Therefore, the Christian worldview on gender and sex takes into account not only the creation of a biological man and a biological woman, but also love, marriage, fidelity, and reproduction. The post Biblical View on Transgender Identity: A Primer appeared first on Focus on the Family.
